title: The research queue's ql_research.NOTE does not read a Closed note, so querylog.py queue keeps a _gaps.md entry the router reads as closed
goal: ql_research.NOTE and SETTLED read a '- Closed <date>:' note under a _gaps.md entry as settling it, as kbfacts.OPEN_GAP does (13 Closed notes in the public root's _gaps.md), and kb/_self/querylog.md says which notes settle an entry for the queue, Narrowed and Partly resolved as the gate before the start decides: the repro exits 0

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_research as q;m=q.NOTE.match('  - Closed 2026-10-10: answered');print('Closed note read:',bool(m and m.group(1) in q.SETTLED));sys.exit(0 if m and m.group(1) in q.SETTLED else 1)

import sys;ls=[x for x in open('kb/_self/querylog.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines() if x.lstrip().startswith('- **Dated notes under the entry**')];print(len(ls),'line(s)');sys.exit(0 if len(ls)==1 and 'Closed <date>' in ls[0] else 1)

gates.question: Which dated notes under a _gaps.md entry settle it for the research queue: Closed only, or Narrowed and Partly resolved too?
options: Closed settles; Narrowed and Partly resolved stay open leads
Closed, Narrowed and Partly resolved all settle
gates.recommendation: Closed settles; Narrowed and Partly resolved stay open leads
gates.answer: Closed settles; Narrowed and Partly resolved stay open leads
